jobs.title: AML/CTF Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. 

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our AML/CTF Compliance Officer, you'll support collaborations across teams to guide the safe innovation and introduction of new products while upholding regulatory integrity. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Identify and assess risks – Detect money laundering and terrorist financing risks, highlight weaknesses, and issue recommendations, taking a leading role in assessing risks specific to card issuing networks, investment platforms, and digital assets.

 - Product compliance – Partner closely with the Product team to support new launches and ensure continuous AML/CTF compliance of existing features.

 - Provide second-line oversight – Oversee first-line transaction monitoring and name screening operations, acting as the ultimate escalation point and conducting deep-dive investigations into high-risk customer relationships.

 - Report suspicious activities – Review suspicious activity and transaction reports to submit to competent authorities.

 - Ensure regulatory compliance – Collaborate with first-line teams to ensure Customer Due Diligence requirements comply with Luxembourg’s legal and regulatory framework.

 - Develop and refine policies – Assist in drafting and reviewing AML/CTF policies, procedures, and guidelines across all product lines.

 - Enhance training and awareness – Contribute to AML/CTF training programs to educate the organization on unique ML/TF risks.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone proactive and analytical, capable of solving complex compliance challenges and balancing rapid innovation with prudent risk management.

 - AML/CTF expertise – 3+ years in AML/CTF Compliance, ideally in a Fintech, with specialised knowledge of ML/TF risks in payments, trading platforms, digital assets, and card networks.

 - Regulatory knowledge – Strong understanding of Luxembourg and EU AML/CTF regulations regarding Customer Due Diligence.

 - QA & monitoring – Hands-on experience conducting compliance quality assurance and monitoring activities.

 - Task management – Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple high-priority tasks with high accuracy under tight deadlines.

 - Problem-solving and communication – Skilled at engaging with stakeholders across various business units to navigate AML/CTF compliance challenges.

 - Mindset & soft skills – Curious and communicative, with a strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

 - 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.



Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. 

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

jobs.title: Inside Business Development Support, Napoli - Part-time (L.68/99)
jobs.description:
📢 Promuoviamo la Diversità: Invitiamo le persone con disabilità a candidarsi! (L.68/99) 🚀

Questo ruolo fa parte del nostro impegno a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Per questo motivo, Satispay dedica questa specifica opportunità a persone con disabilità o appartenenti ad altre categorie protette, in conformità con la legge italiana sulla tutela dell’occupazione (L.68/99). Accogliamo candidature da persone con ogni tipo di percorso.

Non rientri tra i destinatari della L.68/99, ma vorresti comunque candidarti? Crediamo nel valore della diversità e del talento in tutte le sue forme! Se ti interessa questa posizione, ma non rientri tra le persone destinatarie della legge 68/99, clicca su questo link https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/satispay/form/talent-community per candidarti.



Chi siamo

Le banche tradizionali non ti hanno mai dato pieno controllo della tua vita finanziaria. Satispay esiste per cambiare le cose: per mettere il potere della finanza nelle mani delle persone. Questo significa rendere i servizi finanziari semplici e accessibili per oltre 6,5M di utenti. 

Abbiamo iniziato dai pagamenti, poi i benefit, gli investimenti, le carte… e non abbiamo finito. Anzi, siamo solo all’inizio. Ogni volta seguiamo la stessa logica: trovare un problema reale, risolverlo come si deve, e passare al successivo. La destinazione? Costruire la piattaforma finanziaria più amata al mondo. Se ti prendi la responsabilità dei risultati e non solo dei compiti, se resti accanto a ciò di cui le persone hanno bisogno e non aspetti che siano gli altri a sistemare quello che non funziona — qui troverai persone che lavorano esattamente come te. E insieme costruirete qualcosa di cui essere fieri.



Cosa farai con noi

Come Inside Business Development Support, avrai la responsabilità di garantire la qualità dei dati nel nostro CRM, supportando direttamente la crescita e l'efficacia del team Business Development di Napoli. Sarai il pilastro su cui si baserà la nostra strategia commerciale. Ecco cosa significa nella pratica:

 - Gestire e ottimizzare il CRM - Assicurandoti che le informazioni siano sempre complete, coerenti e accurate, pronte per essere utilizzate dal team.

 - Garantire la qualità dei dati - Scovando e correggendo duplicati, formattazioni incoerenti e informazioni incomplete per mantenere il nostro database impeccabile.

 - Arricchire le informazioni commerciali - Verificando che ogni contatto sia collegato all'azienda giusta e che i dati anagrafici (sito web, numero di dipendenti, settore) siano sempre aggiornati e corretti.

 - Supportare le strategie di vendita - Fornendo al team Business Development analisi e insight basati su dati puliti e affidabili, aiutandolo a prendere decisioni migliori e più rapide.



Chi stiamo cercando

Per questo ruolo cerchiamo una persona precisa e con la stoffa del problem-solver, che ami lavorare con i dati e collaborare con il team, curiosa e senza paura di prendersi la responsabilità per garantire la qualità del nostro lavoro.

 - Attenzione al dettaglio - Hai un occhio di falco per le incoerenze e ti appassiona l'idea di rendere i dati perfetti. Hai già lavorato con CRM o hai familiarità con la gestione di informazioni commerciali.

 - Approccio analitico e proattivo - Non ti limiti a eseguire, ma interpreti i dati per supportare le decisioni operative e proponi attivamente miglioramenti ai processi.

 - Dimestichezza con gli strumenti - Hai una buona conoscenza di Google Sheets o Excel, che utilizzerai per analizzare e sistemare i dati.

 - Spirito di squadra e voglia di costruire - Ti piace avere autonomia e responsabilità, ma anche relazionarti costantemente con il team per costruire insieme qualcosa di solido e scalabile.

 - Adattabilità - Ti trovi a tuo agio in ambienti in rapida evoluzione e non ti spaventa affrontare sfide nuove per contribuire a un team in crescita.

Non preoccuparti se non ti riconosci in ogni singolo requisito. Crediamo nella forza di prospettive e talenti diversi. Il tuo punto di vista è importante mentre costruiamo qualcosa di speciale: se hai passione e pensi di poter fare la differenza, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti.



CareAbout: come supportiamo il tuo impatto

Andiamo veloci e la nostra evoluzione non si ferma mai. È un percorso entusiasmante, ma può essere sfidante. Per assicurarci che le nostre persone possano dare il meglio di sé, ci impegniamo a semplificare la loro vita, sia in ufficio che fuori. Ecco perché è nato CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Salute: assicurazione privata per te e la tua famiglia, supporto psicologico con Serenis, workshop sul benessere mentale.

 - 💰 Risorse finanziarie: piano di Stock Option, Buoni Pasto, supporto al trasferimento se cambi Paese.

 - ⚙️ Crescita e sviluppo: programmi di formazione professionale, mobilità interna, corsi di lingua con Preply.

 - 🌱 Flessibilità: ferie illimitate, policy di lavoro ibrido*, orari flessibili.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Famiglia: congedo parentale esteso, permessi extra per malattia dei figli.

*Prevediamo tre giorni a settimana in ufficio (martedì, giovedì + 1 altro giorno a tua scelta), con la possibilità di richiedere periodi extra di lavoro da remoto.



Stipendio: €25,000 - €32,000 lordi all'anno

Questi valori sono definiti sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere, in linea con i requisiti fondamentali della posizione. Tuttavia, crediamo che non si debba imporre un limite al talento. Il pacchetto retributivo finale sarà personalizzato in base alla tua esperienza e alle tue competenze uniche. Se ritieni che il tuo profilo vada oltre i requisiti standard, ti invitiamo a candidarti comunque: saremo felici di valutare insieme un'offerta che rifletta il tuo reale valore.



Pari opportunità

In Satispay, siamo orgogliosi di offrire pari opportunità a chiunque. Valorizziamo la diversità e l'inclusione, accogliendo persone di ogni background. Questa posizione è aperta a tutti, indipendentemente - ad esempio - da etnia, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale o provenienza. Entra in un ambiente di lavoro dove chiunque possa sentirsi a casa!



Scopri di più su di noi

Vuoi sapere com’è davvero lavorare qui? I nostri valori e pilastri guidano il nostro lavoro ogni giorno: scoprili qui. https://www.satispay.com/it-it/lavorare-in-satispay/

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.



What you'll be doing 

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

 - Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

 - Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

 - Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

 - Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

 - Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.



Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

 - 10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.

 - Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).

 - A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.

 - Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.

 - Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.



Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

 - Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.

 - Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.

 - Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

 - Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

 - 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.



*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.



Initial salary: Starting from €65,000 gross per annum 

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

What you'll be doing 

As our Procurement Specialist, you'll implement integrated procurement strategies to support company objectives, manage procurement cost records, ensure departments follow correct procurement flows, optimize buying activities, and continuously monitor key procurement metrics. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Lead vendor negotiations and manage procurement spend - Negotiate with suppliers to secure optimal terms, maximize value, and monitor pricing dynamics and market trends.

 - Support internal stakeholders - Partner with business teams to provide procurement guidance and ensure consistency with company policies.

 - Oversee contract management - Maintain and improve the online Contract Management System, ensuring contracts are up-to-date, compliant, and accessible.

 - Ensure compliance in procurement processes - Enforce adherence to internal procurement procedures and assist teams in following correct approval flows.

 - Track performance and optimize operations - Monitor key procurement KPIs (e.g., cost savings, lead times, contract coverage) and proactively identify areas for improvement.

 - Drive continuous improvement - Refine procurement processes to improve efficiency, enhance service quality, and support scalable operations.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone who is a problem-solver, loves teamwork, and is ready for real ownership in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience - 1+ years in procurement, legal, or administrative functions with a Bachelor’s degree in law, business administration, or related fields. Familiarity with cost management and operational efficiency is a plus.

 - Contract-savvy mindset - Detail-oriented with a strong interest in diving deep into contractual clauses.

 - Negotiation skills & market awareness - Strong negotiation abilities and understanding of supplier dynamics. Experience negotiating media contracts is a strong plus.

 - Strategic and structured thinker - Ability to combine a strategic mindset with hands-on execution.

 - Communication & stakeholder management - Excellent communication skills to convey complex concepts clearly and build trust with vendors and internal teams.

 - Language proficiency - Fluent in Italian and English (spoken and written). Other European languages are a plus.

jobs.title: FP&A Intern
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our FP&A Intern, you'll support our financial planning, budgeting, and performance analysis, providing data-driven insights that empower strategic decision-making across the company.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Support FP&A - Assist in developing the business plan, budgets, and operational analyses to guide strategic decisions.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams - Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Marketing, HR, and Business Development to align financial figures with operational realities and assist in preparing presentation decks for board meetings, investors, or internal reviews.

 - Analyze revenue and costs - Evaluate revenue streams and cost structures to identify areas for improvement and deliver actionable insights that enhance profitability.

 - Maintain financial models and reporting - Keep financial models and reporting tools accurate and up to date to support continuous performance monitoring.

 - Assess strategic initiatives - Assist in evaluating new business opportunities and market trends to support senior leadership's decision-making processes.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone detail-oriented, highly analytical, and passionate about tech-driven financial models and corporate finance.

 - Academic background - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

 - Industry interest - Strong passion for the Fintech ecosystem, digital payments, and tech-driven business models.

 - Finance & Accounting knowledge - Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, corporate finance concepts, and budgeting/forecasting principles.

 - Analytical mindset - Strong attention to detail, proactive approach to identifying risks and opportunities, efficiently managing tasks, meeting deadlines, and translating complex financial data into actionable insights.

 - Financial tools & technical skills - Competency in Excel, with a high level of curiosity and a strong desire to learn how to build, automate, and structure data analysis tools.

 - Soft skills - Collaborative team-player attitude with a growth mindset, eager to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

 - Languages - Fluency in both Italian and English.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout, providing our interns with:

 - 🍴Meal Vouchers (for every day worked)

 - ❤️ Psychological Support (with Serenis)

 - 📚 Language Courses (with Preply)

 - 🌱 Flexibility (Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours)

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.



Salary: €950 monthly internship net gross allowance.



Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!



Learn more about us

Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here https://www.satispay.com/en-it/work-at-satispay/.
